links.comparator_used: DeepSeek-R1 (reasoning-enhanced) compared with DeepSeek-V3 (standard general-purpose) and the ChatGPT-4o models, zero-shot on obstetric anesthesia guideline questions
links.outcome: Accuracy, Overconclusiveness and Completeness ratings (5-point Likert) across models
links.effect: No significant differences across models for Accuracy, Overconclusiveness or Completeness (p > 0.05). The only readability contrast involving R1 was DeepSeek-V3 under BP outperforming R1 under IP on FKGL (p = 0.0294), a comparison that also differs in prompting strategy.
links.quote: No significant differences were found across models for Accuracy, Overconclusiveness, or Completeness (p > 0.05).
